scope: Static source audit, no training progress polling
verified_by_source: Same global deadline passed to every training config
Trainer checkpoints periodically and enforces global deadline minus margin
Supervisor GPU allocation restricted to physical1/2/4/5
Test metrics updated separately from validation checkpoint selection
identified_risk: Controls scheduled only after optional extended stage; too little remaining time can leave extended unlaunchable and starve event controls
recommendation_sent_to_agent: Prioritize frozen holdout event controls and validation candidates before third-seed/extended training; explicitly record budget skips and reserve final audit
